note: Both sets capture the same core facts (−3 dB at corner frequency, 0.25 Hz corner frequency, 0.0125 s time step) with supporting quotes, and both include a redundant duplicate time-step claim. The key difference is entity binding: the page names the component only as the 'generator speed low-pass filter' / 'low-pass filter', so the name 'Baseline Control-Measurement Filter' is invented. Set A uses that unsupported entity on three of its four claims, while Set B binds the substantive claims to the correct filter and only the redundant fourth claim carries the invented name.
